description:
AGENTS.md "What This Is" section (lines 30-32) claims this crate implements
"MDN, plus extension methods for blob upload/download". Neither is true:

  - No `mdn_send` / `MDN/get` / `MDN/set` method exists in src/methods/*.rs.
  - No blob upload/download helper exists (blob upload/download is the
    responsibility of jmap-base-client, called directly via JmapClient).

A contributor who reads AGENTS.md and tries to find these methods will be
confused, then either (a) file a "where is MDN?" issue, or (b) add an MDN
implementation thinking they are completing scope. Either is a maintenance
burden — (b) especially, because it expands the crate beyond PLAN.md scope.

Fix: delete the MDN claim. Either delete the blob upload/download claim, or
reword it to "Composes with jmap-base-client's blob upload/download via
JmapClient::upload / JmapClient::download_blob."
title: AGENTS.md scope claim mentions MDN and blob upload/download not in this crate
